glosses: A children's play area consisting of a box filled with sand.

examples.text: Her children were playing in the sandbox.

glosses: A box filled with sand that is shaped to form a mould for metal casting.
A container for sand or pounce, used historically before blotting paper.
An animal's litter box.
A box carried on locomotives, from which sand runs onto the rails in front of the driving wheels, to prevent slipping.

examples.text: For the most part they were small standard gauge 0-6-0 side tanks of the type illustrated, with long tapered chimneys and an unusual feature for the Continent in the shape of domeless boilers, the protuberance just behind the chimney being a sandbox.

glosses: An isolated area where a program can be executed with a restricted portion of the resources available.

examples.text: Running a program in a sandbox can prevent it from doing any damage to the system.

glosses: A page on a wiki where users are free to experiment without destroying or damaging any legitimate content.
The Middle East.
To restrict (a program, etc.) by placing it in a sandbox.

examples.text: Although you can use standard JavaScript and AJAX in sandboxed iframe pages to your heart's content, the Facebook Platform places restrictions over the amount of scripting capabilities you can add to the more tightly integrated FBML pages.

glosses: To brainstorm; to prototype.

examples.text: Their team has been sandboxing some ideas recently.

examples.text: Originally designed to illustrate Kuwait and the oil pipelines, the 'sandpit', based on maps and photographs to a scale of 1:1,000,000, was extended to include other countries.

glosses: Espace de données spécifique et dédié, destiné à isoler des données ou programmes douteux ou à risque des autres.

examples.text: […] l’appel système futex(2), situé dans le bac à sable seccomp de Linux est autorisé, car cela semble requis par certaines combinaisons glibc/OpenSSL ; […].

glosses: Site web ou page web provisoire hors ligne réservée aux tests avant la mise en ligne.

examples.text: Les nouveaux utilisateurs de ce wiki peuvent faire des essais sans risque sur leur page bac à sable (voir ici).
